t: Praying with shoes on in the mosque
s: Is it permissible to perform ṣalāh while wearing shoes inside the mosque, given that the Prophet ﷺ is reported to have prayed in his sandals?
k: praying with shoes on in the mosque is it permissible to perform salah while wearing shoes inside the mosque given that the prophet is reported to have prayed in his sandals it is permissible in principle and the report is authentic anas may allah be pleased with him was asked whether the prophet prayed in his sandals and he answered the permission is however tied to the shoes being clean where a mosque is carpeted and shoes carry dirt in from the street praying in them soils what has been endowed for prayer so it is avoided not because the act is unlawful in itself but because of the harm attached to it here the practical position is therefore that someone certain his soles are clean may pray in them otherwise he should not sample entry replace with real answers sahih al bukhari kitab al salah bab al salah fi al nial radd al muhtar 1 451
